newsitem.title: USA: UN says has no word of Iraq oil monitor arrests.
newsitem.headline: UN says has no word of Iraq oil monitor arrests.

text.p: U.N. officials in Baghdad have no knowledge of United Nations oil monitors being arrested in northern Iraq, as reported Thursday by the BBC monitoring service, a U.N. spokesman in New York said.
U.N. spokesman Hiro Ueki said definitive word on the situation in northern Iraq would come Friday morning when U.N. offices in Baghdad return to work.
"The U.N. people at headquarters in Baghdad have no knowledge of this (report of missing monitors," said Ueki.

The BBC report, quoting the Iraqi Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK) radio said six U.N. envoys monitoring the distribution of fuel in northern Iraq disappeared this week in areas under the control of the Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP).
Further, the BBC said PUK radio said areas under control of Kurd leader Masud Barzani were arrested by the KDP security forces. --((New York Energy Desk, Patrick Connole, 212 859 1828))
